note: Houston County (MN) publishes its zoning districts only through the Beacon (Schneider) viewer, which has a 'Zoning' layer group but no public ArcGIS REST endpoint found; Beacon blocks automated access (Cloudflare 403). The county zoning ordinance is a PDF. Nearby cities checked: Caledonia publishes its zoning as a static PDF map and La Crescent as a static PDF zoning map; no queryable zoning district service found for the county or these cities. ArcGIS Online and the MN state geospatial portal hold parcels and emergency zones only, no zoning districts.
